Music Theory Reference

A modular reference for music theory fundamentals, with instrument-agnostic theory and instrument mappings.

This is a library, not a single article. The content is organized into two independent layers so the same theory can be reused across instruments:

  • Instrument-agnostic theory — pitch, intervals, scales, chords, rhythm, harmony, and analysis. These pages never mention frets, strings, valves, or bows.
  • Instrument mappings — how abstract theory is realized on a specific instrument. The first mapping is guitar. Other instruments can be added without changing the core theory.

Raw data for developers

The reference includes machine-readable JSON for intervals, scales, chords, and a full guitar fretboard coordinate map. Use it directly in apps or tooling.

  • Data index
  • scale-formulas.json
  • chord-formulas.json
  • intervals.json
  • guitar-fretboard-map.json

Want to add a new instrument, for example piano, bass, or violin? Keep instrument-specific content in its own mapping folder and leave the core theory untouched. See the instrument mapping template in the repo for the recommended workflow.
